readmeExcerpt: # Google AI Edge Gallery ✨ **Explore, Experience, and Evaluate the Future of On-Device Generative AI with Google AI Edge.** AI Edge Gallery is the premier destination for running the world's most powerful open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) on your mobile device. Experience high-performance Generative AI directly on your hardware—fully offline, private, and lightning-fast. **Now Featuring: [XR Language Teacher](https://developers.googleblog.com/on-device-speech-recognition-and-text-to-speech-in-google-ai-edge-gallery/)** The latest version brings official support for the newly released EmbeddingGemma 2 model. With this release, we bring cutting edge, multimodal semantic search running 100% on your device. Try out these new capabilities in our new features Instant Media Search and Video Moment Finder. | **Install the app today from Google Play** | **Install the app today from App Store** | **Download for macOS** | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | | | | For users without Google Play access, install the apk from the [**latest release**](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/releases/latest/) ## App Preview ## ✨ Core Features * **Agent Skills**: Transform your LLM from a conversationalist into a proactive assistant. Use the Agent Skills tile to augment model capabilities with tools like Wikipedia for fact-grounding, interactive maps, and rich visual summary cards. You can even load modular skills from a URL or browse community contributions on GitHub Discussions. * **AI Chat with ASR & TTS**: Talk to your model instead of typing. Tap the mic button to dictate your message with on-device speech recognition, and tap the speaker on any reply (or turn on auto-play) to hear it read aloud. Choose your speech recognition and text-to-speech engines, voices, and languages in the chat's Audio settings. * **XR Language Teacher**: Learn a new language from the world around you. Point your camera at an object and ask about it by image, voice, or text. Your AI teacher answers in the language you're learning, reads the answer aloud, and turns key words into vocabulary cards you can save and study later. Use it on your phone, or hands-free with supported Android XR glasses. * **Instant Media Search**: Explore your photo library (or built-in sample media) with fast, search-as-you-type natural language queries and image-to-image similarity matching—with zero cloud roundtrips. * **Video Moment Finder**: Pinpoint exact moments inside videos using natural language descriptions. Jump straight to highlighted timestamps on an interactive timeline, trim clips, and save or export your favorite moments * **Ask Image**: Use multimodal power to identify objects, solve visual puzzles, or get detailed descriptions using your device’s camera or photo gallery. * **Audio Scribe**: Transcribe and translate voice recordings into text in real-time using high-efficiency on-device language models. * **Prompt Lab**: A dedicated workspace to test different prompts and single-turn use cases with granular control over model parameters like temperature and top-k. * **Mobile Actions**: Unlock offline device controls and automated tasks powered entirely by a finetune of FunctionGemma 270m. * **Tiny Garden**: A fun, experimental mini-game that uses natural language to plant and harvest a virtual garden using a finetune of FunctionGemma 270m. * **Model Management & Benchmark**: Gallery is a flexible sandbox for a wide variety of open-source models. Easily download models from the list or load your own custom models. Manage your model library effortlessly and run benchmark tests to understand exactly how each model performs on your specific hardware. * **100% On-Device Privacy**: All model inferences happen directly on your device hardware. No internet is required, ensuring total privacy for your prompts, images, and sensitive data. ## 🏁 Get Started in Minutes! 1. **Check OS Requirement**: Android 12 and up, and iOS 17 and up. 2. **Download the App:** - Install the app from [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.ai.edge.gallery) or [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/google-ai-edge-gallery/id6749645337). - For users without Google Play access: install the apk from the [**latest release**](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/releases/latest/) 3. **Install & Explore:** For detailed installation instructions (including for corporate devices) and a full user guide, head over to our [**Project Wiki**](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/wiki)! ## 🛠️ Technology Highlights * **Google AI Edge:** Core APIs and tools for on-device ML. * **LiteRT:** Lightweight runtime for optimized model execution. * **Hugging Face Integration:** For model discovery and download. ## ⌨️ Development Check out the [development notes](DEVELOPMENT.md) for instructions about how to build the app locally. ## 🤝 Feedback This is an **experimental Beta release**, and your input is crucial! * 🐞 **Found a bug?** [Report it here!](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/issues/new?assignees=&labels=bug&template=bug_report.md&title=%5BBUG%5D) * 💡 **Have an idea?** [Suggest a feature!](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/issues/new?assignees=&labels=enhancement&template=feature_request.md&title=%5BFEATURE%5D) ## 📄 License Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. ## 🔗 Useful Links * [**Project Wiki (Detailed Guides)**](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/wiki) * [Hugging Face LiteRT Community](https://huggingface.co/litert-community) * [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM) * [Google AI Edge Documentation](https://ai.google.dev/edge)
readmeHtml:
Google AI Edge Gallery ✨

Explore, Experience, and Evaluate the Future of On-Device Generative AI with Google AI Edge.

AI Edge Gallery is the premier destination for running the world's most powerful open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) on your mobile device. Experience high-performance Generative AI directly on your hardware—fully offline, private, and lightning-fast.

Now Featuring: XR Language Teacher

The latest version brings official support for the newly released EmbeddingGemma 2 model. With this release, we bring cutting edge, multimodal semantic search running 100% on your device. Try out these new capabilities in our new features Instant Media Search and Video Moment Finder.

Install the app today from Google Play Install the app today from App Store Download for macOS

For users without Google Play access, install the apk from the latest release

App Preview

✨ Core Features

  • Agent Skills: Transform your LLM from a conversationalist into a proactive assistant. Use the Agent Skills tile to augment model capabilities with tools like Wikipedia for fact-grounding, interactive maps, and rich visual summary cards. You can even load modular skills from a URL or browse community contributions on GitHub Discussions.

  • AI Chat with ASR & TTS: Talk to your model instead of typing. Tap the mic button to dictate your message with on-device speech recognition, and tap the speaker on any reply (or turn on auto-play) to hear it read aloud. Choose your speech recognition and text-to-speech engines, voices, and languages in the chat's Audio settings.

  • XR Language Teacher: Learn a new language from the world around you. Point your camera at an object and ask about it by image, voice, or text. Your AI teacher answers in the language you're learning, reads the answer aloud, and turns key words into vocabulary cards you can save and study later. Use it on your phone, or hands-free with supported Android XR glasses.

  • Instant Media Search: Explore your photo library (or built-in sample media) with fast, search-as-you-type natural language queries and image-to-image similarity matching—with zero cloud roundtrips.

  • Video Moment Finder: Pinpoint exact moments inside videos using natural language descriptions. Jump straight to highlighted timestamps on an interactive timeline, trim clips, and save or export your favorite moments

  • Ask Image: Use multimodal power to identify objects, solve visual puzzles, or get detailed descriptions using your device’s camera or photo gallery.

  • Audio Scribe: Transcribe and translate voice recordings into text in real-time using high-efficiency on-device language models.

  • Prompt Lab: A dedicated workspace to test different prompts and single-turn use cases with granular control over model parameters like temperature and top-k.

  • Mobile Actions: Unlock offline device controls and automated tasks powered entirely by a finetune of FunctionGemma 270m.

  • Tiny Garden: A fun, experimental mini-game that uses natural language to plant and harvest a virtual garden using a finetune of FunctionGemma 270m.

  • Model Management & Benchmark: Gallery is a flexible sandbox for a wide variety of open-source models. Easily download models from the list or load your own custom models. Manage your model library effortlessly and run benchmark tests to understand exactly how each model performs on your specific hardware.

  • 100% On-Device Privacy: All model inferences happen directly on your device hardware. No internet is required, ensuring total privacy for your prompts, images, and sensitive data.

🏁 Get Started in Minutes!

  1. Check OS Requirement: Android 12 and up, and iOS 17 and up.
  2. Download the App:
    • Install the app from Google Play or App Store.
    • For users without Google Play access: install the apk from the latest release
  3. Install & Explore: For detailed installation instructions (including for corporate devices) and a full user guide, head over to our Project Wiki!

🛠️ Technology Highlights

  • Google AI Edge: Core APIs and tools for on-device ML.
  • LiteRT: Lightweight runtime for optimized model execution.
  • Hugging Face Integration: For model discovery and download.

⌨️ Development

Check out the development notes for instructions about how to build the app locally.

🤝 Feedback

This is an experimental Beta release, and your input is crucial!

  • 🐞 Found a bug? Report it here!
  • 💡 Have an idea? Suggest a feature!

📄 License

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See the LICENSE file for details.

🔗 Useful Links

  • Project Wiki (Detailed Guides)
  • Hugging Face LiteRT Community
  • LiteRT-LM
  • Google AI Edge Documentation

releases.body:
- New in XR Language Teacher: Practice vocabulary with new Tap modes in Vocab Popper and Buddy Runner study games (no microphone required), with higher score streaks and combo multipliers.
- Audio & Speech Polish: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech stability fixes and performance improvements.
- Fix a bug related to "Some ops are not accelerated" or "GPU accelerator is not supported on this device".

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/compare/1.0.21...1.0.23
Enabling Gemma4-e2b for XR Language Teacher

- Speak and listen with on-device ASR and TTS models
- Learn new languages with XR language teacher
- Better chat experience - now you can chat infinitely with context management
- See inference telemetry live with Live metrics HUD
- Bug fixes

Now Featuring: [EmbeddingGemma 2](https://developers.googleblog.com/google-ai-edge-with-embeddinggemma-2/)

This update brings official support for the newly released EmbeddingGemma 2 model. With this release, we bring cutting edge, multimodal semantic search running 100% on your device. Try out these new capabilities in our new features Instant Media Search and Video Moment Finder. 

- Instant Media Search: Explore your photo library (or built-in sample media) with fast, search-as-you-type natural language queries and image-to-image similarity matching—with zero cloud roundtrips.

- Video Moment Finder: Pinpoint exact moments inside videos using natural language descriptions. Jump straight to highlighted timestamps on an interactive timeline, trim clips, and save or export your favorite moments

## What's Changed
* Temporarily remove media and storage permissions from AndroidManifest by @copybara-service[bot] in https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/pull/1076
* Refactor `showBenchmarkButton` configuration to `isBenchmarkSupported` and `showBenchmarkActionButton` by @copybara-service[bot] in https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/pull/1080
* Add support for extra data files in the Android model allowlist. This change introduces the ModelDataFile data class to represent supplementary files that need to be downloaded alongside a main model. by @copybara-service[bot] in https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/pull/1088
* Automatically reset chat session with previous history when resuming after interruption by @copybara-service[bot] in https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/pull/1093
* Use hugging face api to fetch model size. by @copybara-service[bot] in https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/pull/1090
* Updating Terms of Service statement. by @copybara-service[bot] in https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery/pull/1096
* Introduce LlmSessionManager to orchestrate LLM chat sessions and persistence. by @copybara-service[bot] in https://github.com/google-a

aiSummary.oneLiner: A mobile application showcasing powerful on-device Generative AI models running completely offline.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: AI Edge Gallery is a premier application developed by Google to demonstrate the capabilities of running Large Language Models directly on mobile hardware. The app allows users to interact with high-performance models, like the Gemma 4 family, entirely offline, ensuring absolute privacy and fast response times. It provides a versatile sandbox environment featuring AI chat, multimodal image analysis, and real-time audio transcription. Developers can use the app's Prompt Lab to test specific use cases and benchmark how different open-source models perform on their specific device hardware. The gallery serves as both a consumer showcase and a developer tool for on-device AI integration.
keyFeatures: Offline Inference: Executes all AI models locally on the device hardware, requiring no internet connection and guaranteeing data privacy.
Agent Skills: Augments local models with interactive tools, rich visual summary cards, and fact-grounding capabilities.
Thinking Mode: Provides a transparent view into the model's step-by-step reasoning process during complex problem-solving.
Multimodal Support: Includes tools for real-time audio transcription and visual analysis using the device's camera.
Hardware Benchmarking: Allows developers to download various models and run precise performance tests on their specific mobile hardware.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This application is designed for AI enthusiasts, mobile developers, and researchers interested in the cutting edge of on-device machine learning. It provides a hands-on way to experience and evaluate local Generative AI capabilities.
